observations.fact: Ciphertext destruction globally synchronizes before returning polynomial buffers; the patch explains reads on output-owned streams.
LoadPlaintext returns for loaded GPU plaintexts, otherwise needs the CPU plaintext representation.
GPU EvalMult(ciphertext,plaintext) reads the loaded GPU plaintext and copies the ciphertext result.
Plaintext GetLevel reads CPU metadata and returns zero without CPU storage.
Device registry lock calls are commented out; concurrent GPU registry access is not a valid assumed preparation worker policy.
multPt may create a private adjusted plaintext for differing levels or degree two; immutable cache data cannot simply be mutated.
